svg.title: IRONBOUND — Assassin ASN-21 record
svg.desc: Landscape Assassin ASN-21 record with fixed weapon TICs, pilot fields, and armor/structure tracking.

g.text: Effects cumulative; ammo risk if eligible.
Mech only · EV reference G4 / P5 · Normal access
IF: indirect fire. Each row is one bin; shared by listed TICs. Spend 1 shot per weapon fired.
Equipment: Standard engine, gyro and structure; standard armor; single heat sinks.
